model.costScope: Full recorded recipient gross expense; only Market Match nutrition health priced, unrecognized outside resources unknown. The full annual budget is a ratio normalization, not a requested donation or verified funding tranche. Applying the ratio to an ordinary small gift assumes locally proportional capacity response and the stated component allocation.
model.geographicAttribution: g=.98 subjective LA/Orange shopper-health share, not farmer-location attribution.
model.formula: Q = R × (q/u) × a × b × g / (1+d); R=1224579,u=240,q=.005,a=.5,b=.25,g=.98,d=.03. One year only. Price10=10*C/Q only when Q>0. Qportfolio=Q+Qother-H; Qother unknown.
model.counterfactual: Other incentive programs, existing CalFresh purchases, public reimbursement and alternative food sources continue. a adjusts dietary transfer and replacement; b adjusts marginal funding response.
model.attribution: Redeemed incentive dollars become exposure-equivalent household-years, not counted transactions. One adult trajectory per equivalent, finite one year. No lifetime or farmer-income health multiplication.
model.uncertainty: All health, exposure, funding response and geography parameters are explicit uncalibrated priors. Positive joint cases are not confidence bounds; no probability-weighted expected value is claimed. Zero, adverse and unknown whole-portfolio cases remain.
model.nativeOutcomes: $1,224,579 redeemed incentives; 67,183 transactions. Neither is a measured clinical outcome. 5,102.4125 standardized exposure equivalents is a normalization, not a unique household count.

inputs.name: C
inputs.rationale: Full Part IX; no netted costs shown.

inputs.name: R
inputs.rationale: Not total customer spending or all reported grants.

inputs.name: u
inputs.rationale: Normalization, not observed annual uptake; test120–480. Source IDs provide context only, not empirical calibration of this parameter.

inputs.name: a
inputs.rationale: HIP differs from local matching; test .2–.8. Source IDs provide context only, not empirical calibration of this parameter.

inputs.name: b
inputs.rationale: Public reimbursement and other-donor substitution; test .05–.75. Source IDs provide context only, not empirical calibration of this parameter.

inputs.name: q
inputs.unit: finite QALY per additional exposure-equivalent year
inputs.rationale: No observed local health utility; test0–.02; no lifetime benefit. Treat this as conditional net first-year health area, inclusive of competing mortality, intervention burden and benefit fade within the year; it is not a utility level maintained for every survivor. Source IDs provide context only, not empirical calibration of this parameter.

inputs.name: g
inputs.rationale: Shopper geography not verified; test .9–1. Source IDs provide context only, not empirical calibration of this parameter.

inputs.name: d
inputs.rationale: No post-year persistence. Source IDs provide context only, not empirical calibration of this parameter.

inputs.name: Qother
inputs.rationale: Policy, enrollment and food delivery unresolved.

inputs.name: volunteerShadowWage
inputs.rationale: 2,256 observed delivery volunteer hours; no asserted market wage or comprehensive societal costing.

scenarios.label: Conditional alpha-comparable prior
scenarios.assumptions: One-year net health only. Not empirically calibrated. Full recipient expense, one adult trajectory per standardized equivalent, no household multiplier.

scenarios.label: Lower finite health prior
scenarios.assumptions: One-year net health only. Judgment sensitivity motivated by null clinical trial findings; not a quantitative Bayesian update or trial estimate.

scenarios.label: Mostly reimbursable/substituted gift
scenarios.assumptions: One-year net health only. Current renewals may substitute for private funding; no measured HALA elasticity.

scenarios.label: Hypothetical additional capacity, not yet documented
scenarios.assumptions: One-year net health only. Requires a verifiable unfunded queue and marginal delivery budget; neither located.

scenarios.label: 960 USD annual exposure required
scenarios.assumptions: One-year net health only. Holds per-equivalent q fixed: changes substantive dose requirement, not just units. Inspired by 80USD/month trial dose, not HALA exposure.

scenarios.label: Pure unit re-expression
scenarios.assumptions: One-year net health only. Doubling u and q leaves q/u and results unchanged. Prevents normalization from creating benefit.

scenarios.label: Recipient plus observed-hour opportunity-cost allowance
scenarios.assumptions: One-year net health only. 25USD/hour is an assumed shadow wage. Donated food already recognized; no second food add. Not full societal cost.

scenarios.label: Higher volunteer opportunity-cost allowance
scenarios.assumptions: One-year net health only. 50USD/hour assumption; outside administration and shopper time still unmeasured.

scenarios.label: Joint weak positive case
scenarios.assumptions: One-year net health only. Joint scenario, not confidence bound.

scenarios.label: Joint favorable positive case
scenarios.assumptions: One-year net health only. Multiple favorable unsupported assumptions; not demonstrated bargain or recommendation.

scenarios.label: No incremental health or capacity
scenarios.assumptions: One-year net health only. Public replacement, no marginal service response or zero clinical effect remains plausible. No positive price.

scenarios.label: Illustrative local net harm
scenarios.assumptions: Direct one-year local harm stress from displacement/burdens; g=1 for harmed population. Not observed and not inferred from the diabetes trial.

scenarios.label: Whole portfolio unestimated
scenarios.assumptions: Food delivery, WIC, enrollment, policy and externalities remain unknown; not assumed zero.

sensitivity: Retained alpha-comparable central $9.77m per 10; lower health prior $48.86m; funding response .10 gives $24.43m.
Pure unit re-expression doubles both u and q and preserves the result; changing only u assumes a different dose response.
Volunteer allowance at $25/hour adds $56,400; recognized donated food is not added again.
At full annual cost, $1m per 10 needs 29.65205 local QALYs; central other assumptions require q=.048863, almost ten times the retained prior.
